lines.text: David takes refuge in the LORD and calls Him his rock and fortress, who frees him from a net.
David commits his spirit into the LORD's hands, and the LORD sets his feet in a garden.

wrong_details.wrong: sets his feet in a garden
wrong_details.true: sets his feet in the open

lines.text: David's strength is drained and his bones waste away, and his friends flee when they see him on the street.
David trusts the LORD, says his times are in God's hands, and asks that lying lips be rewarded.

wrong_details.wrong: asks that lying lips be rewarded
wrong_details.true: asks that lying lips be silenced

lines.text: God hides those who take refuge in Him, and David tells all who hope in the LORD to be strong and courageous.
